title: Landing Interaction Contracts and Button Audit
description: ตรวจปุ่มและลิงก์ Landing แบบใช้งานจริง พร้อมรวม navigation, app entry และ Login behavior ไว้ใน interaction contract ที่มี unit tests ป้องกัน regression.
scope: single interaction contract for Landing navigation, hero action, app details, app entry, footer and Login
manual audit of public navigation, app readiness locks, Roadmap refresh and enterprise form availability
preview-safe Login status behavior and configured Google-login callback contract
regression tests to prevent route/readiness drift
verification: manual audit passes for brand, apps, Hermes, Roadmap, enterprise, Login, all four app detail cards, ESTIMETR entry and locked app states
eslint, 6 Vitest files / 16 tests, TypeScript, credential-less Vercel production build, security preflight, roadmap validation and diff hygiene pass
GitHub push and private preview verification pending
rollback: Return to tag v0.12.1-concise-landing. No schema, customer data, price source, payment or export artifact changes.
constraints: All four categories must render their related application card immediately beneath the heading; no filter, launcher or hidden catalog state is allowed.
No numeric package price may appear before the commercial package is approved.
Landing must not expose internal trial capability, AI, BOQ, export or technical preview details that belong inside an application.
Coming-soon and restricted applications must not link users into an unready workspace.
Every public Landing interaction must have an explicit destination or a user-visible safe status.
